grh_7918d61a88f75040e666.title: Valerie and Walter Benton - Murder
paragraphs: Walter Benton, newly recovered from heart surgery and ready to leave Blair, falls seven stories to his death just after receiving $25,000 in cash and a valuable ring from the hospital safe. Because ambulance driver Wayman reaches the body first, suspicion falls on him when the money and ring are missing, and the ring is later planted to strengthen the case against him. Benton's estranged stepdaughter Valerie blames attorney Bill Walsh, but Kildare draws her out until she describes exactly how the killer could have entered disguised, robbed Benton and pushed him from the window; he then confronts her with evidence from the planted ring, and she pulls a gun while police listen in. Valerie is exposed as the killer who robbed and murdered her stepfather, and Wayman is cleared, with Dr. Carrou quietly revealed as the person who posted his bail.

grh_7911fb27da5b069a3fd3.title: Where Guardian Angels Fear to Tread
paragraphs: Michael McLeod, an impulsive guardian angel with a weakness for earthly fun, is sent down to help Kate McCall, an exotic dancer whose life and career have become increasingly chaotic. Taking human form, Michael becomes involved with Kate and her manager Teddy, repeatedly bending heavenly rules as he tries to protect her and keep her out of trouble. Instead of maintaining the detachment expected of a guardian angel, he falls in love with her. His superiors eventually recall him and make clear that he cannot continue crossing the line between guardian and mortal. Michael chooses to give up his angelic powers and memory so that he can return to earth as an ordinary man. Kate does not understand where he has been, but the two are reunited and begin their relationship again without the supernatural complications.

grh_79bc8c029e25fbfe1f52.title: Jack and the Energy Crunch
paragraphs: A satirical fairy tale sends Jack Jr. from energy-dependent Yo-Huppetsville on a quest after the village exhausts its oil. Guided by a talking avocado, he encounters a nature-loving witch, an energy corporation, a giant and a wizard who finally gives him a magical orb providing limitless energy. Jack returns a hero but turns the new power source into a monopoly, raises prices, crushes opposition and becomes the same kind of energy tyrant he once challenged. The wizard returns, takes back the orb because Jack abused it, and leaves him facing the renewed crisis and the public consequences of having confused control of energy with ownership of it.

grh_798bae42c6ae6a85afae.title: Story of a Secret State
paragraphs: Polish officer Jan Karski recounts how the German invasion destroys his prewar life and draws him into the Polish underground. He describes the clandestine courts, sabotage, forged documents, financing and resistance networks that keep an underground state functioning under occupation. Karski is eventually smuggled into the Warsaw ghetto, where he witnesses starvation, terror and random killing. He escapes Poland carrying evidence of Nazi crimes and resolves to report to the outside world what the underground and the persecuted population are enduring.
